# What each client offers

What each Briareus client offers, feature by feature, against the server API (/api/v1). Support is full, partial, none, or n/a (the platform cannot, not merely does not). Audited from each client's code on 2026-10-11; update it in the same pull request that adds or removes a feature in a client.

● full · ◐ partial · `·` none · – n/a (the platform cannot)

| | Windows | Mac | iPhone/iPad | Quest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ● full | 62 | 73 | 53 | 30 |
| ◐ partial | 4 | 4 | 5 | 8 |
| · none | 22 | 11 | 29 | 49 |
| – n/a | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |

## Connection & pairing

| Feature | Windows | Mac | iPhone/iPad | Quest | Notes |
| --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | --- |
| **Pair with a device token**<br>Connect to an HTTPS server with a per-device token kept in the OS secure store. | ● | ● | ● | ● | **iPhone/iPad:** CarPlay cannot pair; the phone does. |
| **Adapt to server and token**<br>Controls the server lacks, or the token may not call, are hidden or disabled (Read-only tokens can't write). | ● | ● | ● | ● |  |
| **Revoke token from the app**<br>Revoke this device's token on the server, not just forget it locally. | · | · | ● | ● | **Windows:** Sign-out forgets the token locally without revoking it on the server. **Mac:** Sign-out (Store.forget) is local only; revoke_token is in the core table but unused by the Mac UI. |
| **Saved state and incremental resume**<br>Screens open on cached projects, conversations and transcripts, then fetch only what changed. | ● | ● | ● | ● | **Quest:** Encrypted on the headset. |
| **Live session updates**<br>Session lists and transcripts update in real time over server-sent events. | ◐ | ● | ◐ | ● | **Windows:** Polls with backoff; never opens /events or /sessions/{id}/events. **iPhone/iPad:** Polls GET /sessions/{id}; no SSE except the shared browser stream. |
| **Self-update**<br>Checks GitHub releases, verifies and installs updates. | ● | ● | – | · | **iPhone/iPad:** Distributed via App Store/TestFlight. **Quest:** Sideloaded APK with no updater; Android could install updates. |

## Server routes no client calls

- **slack (inbox):** `GET /slack/workspaces`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/people`, `POST /slack/workspaces/{id}/direct-messages`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/messages`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/threads/{ts}`, `POST /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/messages`, `POST /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/read`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/events`, `GET /slack/requests`
- **whatsapp:** `all 10 /whatsapp/accounts/* routes`
- **sessions.btw:** `POST /sessions/{id}/btw`
- **sessions.qaLoop:** `POST /sessions/{id}/qa-loop`
- **sessions.linkPr:** `POST /sessions/{id}/link-pr`
- **pulls.checks / pulls.commits:** `GET /pulls/{number}/checks`, `GET /pulls/{number}/commits`
- **ssh.requests:** `GET /ssh/requests`
- **envoyer (single items):** `GET /envoyer/accounts/{id}/projects/{project}`, `GET /envoyer/accounts/{id}/projects/{project}/deployments/{deployment}`
- **deployments.config (read):** `GET /deployments/config`
- **prompts.update:** `PUT /prompts/{id}`
